collective.status: Product naming proposal mapped onto existing modules. It is not deployment status: maturity comes from the linked register rows, and several capabilities have no row yet.
rules: Every agent has bounded authority: none may approve science or promote to the graph; publication needs ARBITER and an authorised human decision.
Every handoff preserves source id, passage digest, context, uncertainty, policy status and run version.
Verification is independent of investigation: VERITAS checks original passages with separately configured models.

agents.name: NEXUS
agents.purpose: Coordinates an investigation: scope, task order, dependencies, bounded execution, recovery.
agents.humanApproval: Durable job runner decision and the held-migration decision before hosted persistence.
agents.nameCollision: An Aksh Health clinical agent has the same name (docs/AKSH_AGENTS_IN_HSI.md). Always write HSI NEXUS.

agents.name: AEGIS
agents.purpose: Decides CLEAR, REVIEW or BLOCK for a source and use inside a human-approved policy, and issues signed receipts through a signer.
agents.humanApproval: A named human signs the clearance policy; a managed signer and an independent clearance authority are appointed.

agents.name: WARDEN
agents.fullName: Runtime reliability, security and cost control
agents.purpose: Enforces budgets, rate limits, kill switches and fail-closed containment around provider and source calls.
agents.humanApproval: Operators, budgets, a shared rate limiter and alerting infrastructure.

agents.name: SCOUT
agents.purpose: Searches approved providers, resolves identifiers and prepares candidate sources and passages, only through the host allow-list and request budget.
agents.humanApproval: Source-policy owner approves hosts, terms and quotas.

agents.name: LANTERN
agents.purpose: Extracts one evidence unit from one cleared passage; every context value must be an exact quote stored as a span, otherwise a gap.
agents.humanApproval: An approved model deployment and terms; a scientist reviews the normalizer registry.

agents.name: ATLAS
agents.purpose: Holds typed, versioned, evidence-linked entities and relationships; accepts candidate edges as proposals only.
nonResponsibilities: publish without an authorised review decision
agents.humanApproval: Canonical investigation store decision; held migrations; publication only after ARBITER and a human decision.
agents.nameCollision: An Aksh Health agent has the same name. Always write HSI ATLAS.

agents.name: HELIX
agents.purpose: Investigates mechanisms across domains from evidence units and graph context, and proposes candidate mechanisms.
nonResponsibilities: cite evidence it was not given
agents.humanApproval: Model deployment approval; the model-backed step is not built yet, today it is deterministic.

agents.name: PARALLAX
agents.purpose: Decides whether findings agree, genuinely conflict, are not comparable or lack evidence, from structured context and deterministic rules.
nonResponsibilities: treat an empty search as agreement
agents.humanApproval: Scientist review of the context normalizer registry.

agents.name: VANTAGE
agents.purpose: Identifies missing evidence and proposes falsifiable experiments, always labelled unvalidated.
agents.humanApproval: A model-backed proposer needs model approval and a preregistered comparison; today it is deterministic.

agents.name: VERITAS
agents.purpose: Challenges each claim against its own source passage with independent verifiers; abstains rather than agreeing.
nonResponsibilities: see the investigator's narrative instead of the passage
count a single model as independent
agents.humanApproval: At least two distinct approved verifier deployments, separate from the extractor.

agents.name: ARBITER
agents.purpose: Assembles review packets and routes them to authenticated, scoped, independent human reviewers; records immutable decisions.
agents.humanApproval: Reviewer appointments, scoped authority and the held-migration decision.

agents.name: SENTINEL
agents.purpose: Re-checks sources and policy on a schedule, revokes receipts that no longer hold and flags affected claims.
agents.humanApproval: A scheduler, an owner and a place for the policy-revocation list.

agents.name: CALIBER
agents.purpose: Runs expert-adjudicated benchmarks and baselines; reports accuracy, abstention and reproducibility with separate provenance and safety gates.
agents.humanApproval: Appointed experts, a private vault and conflict declarations.
